Your customers are searching. The question is - can they find you?

  • 93% of online experiences start with a search engine - if you're not visible, you're invisible.
  • Over 60% of Google searches now end without a click, with users taking answers directly from AI Overviews.
  • 1 in 4 people are already using AI tools like ChatGPT to find and recommend businesses.

This report reviews how ready your website is for both worlds: Search (SEO) and AI Answers (AEO). Think of it as making sure your website works as hard as you do.

Critical & Important Findings

High & Medium Severity

Four findings requiring attention to improve search visibility and AI extraction.

Website Health
Website health
Good Severity
The website appears to be technically sound, with no immediate critical issues detected from the provided information.
Commercial ConsequenceA healthy technical foundation ensures search engines can efficiently crawl, index, and rank the website, contributing to organic visibility.
→Continue to monitor core web vitals and server logs for any emerging technical issues.
⚡ Quick win Priority 1
Google Listing
H1 tag optimisation
High Severity
The page contains multiple H1 tags, including 'LA LUCHA MASK' and 'CATERING'. Best practice dictates a single, descriptive H1 tag per page that accurately reflects the main content.
Commercial ConsequenceMultiple or irrelevant H1 tags can confuse search engines about the page's primary topic, potentially hindering its ability to rank for relevant keywords and reducing organic traffic.
→Revise the page's content structure to ensure only one H1 tag is present, clearly describing the main subject of the page. For example, 'Authentic Mexican flavours' or 'Mad Mex menu'.
🔧 Light lift Priority 2
Business Identity
Schema markup implementation
Good Severity
The website successfully implements JSON-LD schema markup, including FAQ schema.
Commercial ConsequenceComprehensive schema markup helps search engines understand the content and context of the website, potentially leading to rich results in SERPs and improved click-through rates.
→Regularly review and update schema markup to ensure it remains accurate and aligned with the latest schema.org guidelines and business offerings.
⚡ Quick win Priority 3
AI Readability
Content hierarchy for AEO
Medium Severity
While schema is present, the page's H1 tag usage (multiple and potentially irrelevant) suggests a suboptimal content hierarchy that may not clearly signal the main topic to AI answer engines.
Commercial ConsequenceA poorly structured content hierarchy can make it difficult for AI to extract key information, reducing the likelihood of the website appearing in featured snippets or direct answers.
→Ensure that content is logically organised with clear headings (H1, H2, H3) that guide both users and AI through the page's information, starting with a single, relevant H1.
🛠️ Moderate build Priority 4

Customer Questions
FAQ content and schema alignment
Good Severity
FAQ content is visually present on the /faq page and is correctly marked up with FAQPage schema.
Commercial ConsequenceWell-structured and schema-marked FAQ content enhances visibility in search results, particularly for voice search and AI answer engines, by providing direct answers to user queries.
→Continuously update FAQ content to address common user questions and ensure the schema remains accurate and up-to-date with any content changes.
⚡ Quick win
AI Presence
Holistic AI visibility signals
Medium Severity
The website benefits from strong AI visibility signals through comprehensive JSON-LD and FAQ schema. However, the presence of multiple and potentially irrelevant H1 tags could dilute these signals.
Commercial ConsequenceStrong, consistent AI visibility signals increase the probability of content being understood and surfaced by AI answer engines, driving qualified traffic and brand exposure. Inconsistent signals can hinder this.
→Maintain robust schema implementation and address on-page content hierarchy issues, particularly the H1 tags, to provide a clear and unambiguous signal to AI answer engines about the page's core topic.
🛠️ Moderate build
